releases.notes: This is a bugfix release to handle advancements from datapacks that have empty details in their display. Advancements will now only be sent to Discord if they are also announced to the Minecraft chat ([`announce_to_chat`](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Advancement/JSON_format) is `true`).
This is a simple update to Minecraft 1.20.4.
This is a simple update to Minecraft 1.20.0
Thus is a simple update to Minecraft 1.19.4

Changes in this release:
- Refactored to use Fabric API's new `ServerLivingEntityEvents.AFTER_DEATH` event.
- Updated to Minecraft 1.19.3

Changes in this release:
- Lots of refactoring to clean up the codebase.
- `config.json` is even more organized into subobjects.
- Pending verifications now have a configurable timeout, defaulting to 10 minutes as before.
- Linking codes can now include leading zeros, so they now range from 0 to one million.
- Configuration reloads! `/discord reload`
- No more mentioning of players from discord via the `!+` prefix.
- Senders of Discord messages will be coloured according to their role in Minecraft, with hovering showing the Discord tag.
  - If linked, Minecraft will show the player name instead, but still coloured by Discord role.
- User mentions in messages are displayed in Minecraft just like senders (coloured, maps names for linked profiles)
- Roles mentioned in Discord messages will be coloured in Minecraft according to the role's color.
- Channels mentioned in Discord message will be shown as a clickable URL in Minecraft.

Configurations made for 1.0 will not be compatible with 1.1 and will need updating. This isn't automatic because I don't have any users yet :smile: . Recommended way to upgrade is to rename `config.json`, then start the server so a new one is created. Then copy data from the old config into the corresponding places in the new one. The main differences are:
- `"enableLogsForwarding"`  is under `"discord"` now.
- `"enableAccountLinking"` and `"forceLinking"` are now `"enable"` and `"required"` under the new `"linking"` key.
- `"playerIconUrl"` is now `"icon"` under the new `"renderUrls"` key.
- The keys under `"avatarUrls"` should be moved under `"renderUrls"`, next to the `"icon"` key.

readmeSummary: A Minecraft-Discord bridge targeting the latest Minecraft version and focused on consistent and convenient configurations.
